FailureNotCounted.because: A failed call is not counted, so the limit on calls is never reached and a report can be retried forever.

RetryWithNewReportId.because: Each retry sends a new report id, so the service stores the same report under two ids.

SendSkipsReview.because: A report is sent straight after it is built, even when a review was required.

TimeoutCountsAsSent.because: A report is marked sent without an answer from the service, so it can be marked sent when the service never stored it.
